name: Hash Generator
description: MD5, SHA-1, SHA-2, SHA-3 and Keccak-256 hashes, HMAC and file hashing.
longDescription: Hashes text or a file with MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512, SHA3-256, SHA3-512 and Keccak-256, and adds HMAC-SHA256, -SHA384 and -SHA512 with a secret key. The hashing runs in a WebAssembly module inside the plugin. Nothing is uploaded.
